step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture process includes two main flows: real-time ad recommendation and batch machine learning pipeline. 1) Mobile users send ad requests to ALB, which forwards them to an ECS container running on EC2. ECS queries DynamoDB for user features and invokes a SageMaker endpoint for ad predictions. 2) For offline model training, EMR processes raw data from an initial S3 bucket (Data Lake), writes transformed features into a second S3 bucket, which is then accessed by SageMaker for notebook analysis and model training.
